lines.japanese:
爛れきった情交の疲労に蹌踉と、戻ってきた朔屋の足下のあまりの危うさに、さしもの智里も塩辛い顔をしてみせたとかなんだとか。
　なにか言いかける朔屋に、智里は己が額に手を当てる仕草で遮[さえぎ]って、一旦食堂から姿を消して、程なくして戻ってきたその手には、軍用の払い下げと思しき水筒のぶら下げられたる。
lines.japaneseRuby:
[R爛^ただ]れきった情交の疲労に[R蹌踉^そうろう]と、戻ってきた朔屋の足下のあまりの危うさに、さしもの智里も塩辛い顔をしてみせたとかなんだとか。
　なにか言いかける朔屋に、智里は己が額に手を当てる仕草で遮[さえぎ]って、一旦食堂から姿を消して、程なくして戻ってきたその手には、軍用の払い下げと思しき水筒のぶら下げられたる。
lines.english: Sakuya staggered back, exhausted by their decadent coupling. His footing was so precarious that even Tomosato made a sour face—or so the story goes. As he began to speak, Tomosato stopped him with a hand to his own forehead, left the mess, and soon returned with what looked like a military-surplus canteen dangling from his hand.

lines.japanese: 「……まあ呑め。慌てるな、真水だ」
lines.english: “…Drink. Don't panic. It's fresh water.”

lines.japanese: 「でも……今の状況じゃ、真水は貴重なんじゃないのか？」
lines.english: “But… Isn't fresh water precious under these circumstances?”

lines.japanese: 「そういう話もないでもねえが、てめえの有り様見てるとよ」
lines.english: “There's that, sure. But looking at you—”

lines.japanese: 「どうやらあの姐さんにさんざか搾[しぼ]りとられてきたらしいや。かっさかさだぁ。水気を入れとけ少しは」
lines.english: “Seems that lady's wrung you dry. Parched as hell. Get some water in you, at least.”

lines.japanese:
まるで泪の部屋での痴態一部始終を見透かされた覚えして、朔屋、差し出された水筒手に取り、蓋を外して口に運ぶ。喉を通る水は確かに若干饐[す]えた感じはしたものの、智里の推察通り、あの部屋での濃密な空気に晒された体は確かに水分欲しており、体中にしみ込んでいくよう。
　入っていた水の半分ばかりを流し込んで、ようやく朔屋、飲み口を離す。
lines.japaneseRuby:
まるで泪の部屋での痴態一部始終を見透かされた覚えして、朔屋、差し出された水筒手に取り、[R蓋^ふた]を外して口に運ぶ。喉を通る水は確かに若干饐[す]えた感じはしたものの、智里の推察通り、あの部屋での濃密な空気に晒された体は確かに水分欲しており、体中にしみ込んでいくよう。
　入っていた水の半分ばかりを流し込んで、ようやく朔屋、飲み口を離す。
lines.english: Feeling as though every indecency in Rui's room had been seen through, Sakuya took the offered canteen, removed the cap, and raised it to his mouth. The water did taste a little stale. But as Tomosato had guessed, his body, exposed to that room's thick atmosphere, craved moisture. It seemed to soak through him. Only after drinking about half the contents did he lower the canteen.

lines.japanese:
「……っ。その……なんというか、
　なりゆきで」
lines.english: “…Well… What can I say? One thing led to another.”

lines.japanese:
「お前がどこで女を食おうが女郎を買おうが、そんなこたぁどうでもいいんだよ。
　だがよ───飲んだら、口、拭え」
lines.english: “I don't care where you bed women or buy whores. But—wipe your mouth when you've finished drinking.”

lines.japanese:
「紅は魔除けになるたぁ言うが、そこまで口の回りべっとりさせてちゃあ、エロ気が利きすぎだぁ。こっちまで脂くさくなりそうだぜ。
　話をすんにも、その後にしようや、な？」
lines.english: “They say rouge wards off evil, but all that smeared around your mouth is laying the lewdness on a bit thick. I'll be smelling greasy myself next. Wipe it off first, and then we can talk, yeah?”

lines.japanese: 慌てて朔屋、口元を拭えば、その手の甲にはべっとりと、泪の唇を彩っていた紅が伸びた。
lines.english: Sakuya hastily wiped his mouth. A thick smear of the rouge that had colored Rui's lips spread across the back of his hand.

lines.japanese: 上甲板に上がれば四囲は相変わらず酒の海、沸き立つ酒気が夥[おびただ]しい、立っているだけでも酒精体中の毛穴からしみ込んで足元に来そうな。船内にいればいくらかは酒気も避けられるというのに、なぜわざわざと朔屋が殺し屋に訝しげに目問いすれば、智里それは無視して逆に首尾を問う。
lines.english: On the upper deck, the sea was still liquor all around them. So much alcohol rose into the air that merely standing there felt as though it might seep through every pore and make his knees unsteady. Below, they could avoid some of the fumes. Why come up deliberately? Sakuya asked the killer with a suspicious look. Tomosato ignored it and asked how his errand had gone instead.

lines.japanese:
「そんで、どうだった、首尾は？
　あったんだろ、真珠」
lines.english: “So, how'd it go? There were pearls, right?”

lines.japanese: 「……ああ。あるにはあった、というか出てきたというか。ともかく───駄目だああ」
lines.english: “…Yes. There were—or they appeared, perhaps. Anyway… It's no use!”

lines.japanese: 朔屋、そもそもの目的の真珠の行方を思い出し、頭を抱える。確かに、智里の言う通りも真珠はあったとも、あったけれどもそれは今、己の腹の中だという事実。
lines.english: Remembering what had become of the pearls he originally sought, Sakuya clutched his head. Certainly, as Tomosato said, there had been pearls. But one was now inside his belly.

lines.japanese: 「泪さんに飲まされてしまったんだ」
lines.english: “Ms. Rui made me swallow it.”

lines.japanese:
「飲まされたぁ？　
　女ァ抱いてきたに飽きたらず、呑んできたとけつかる。どこの女王様だてめぇは」
lines.english: “Swallow it? Bedding a woman wasn't enough, you had to drink it down too? What queen do you think you are?”

lines.japanese:
「……面目次第も……。
　あ。君もしかして、その長物で僕の腹を切開して取り出そうとか考えてないだろうな。
　そんな事したって、もうきっと消化液に浸食されてるぞ、故売屋だって買い取ってくれないぞ」
lines.english: “…I've no excuse… Wait. You're not thinking of cutting my belly open with that long thing to take it out, are you? It's probably being eaten away by digestive juices already. Even a secondhand dealer wouldn't buy it.”

lines.japanese: 「アホくさい。お前の腸[はらわた]かっ捌いたってなにが面白い。お前の酒まみれの肝[キモ]なんざ、それこそ薬種商だって買い取りゃしねえ」
lines.japaneseRuby: 「アホくさい。お前の腸[はらわた]かっ[R捌^さば]いたってなにが面白い。お前の酒まみれの肝[キモ]なんざ、それこそ[R薬種商^きぐすりや]だって買い取りゃしねえ」
lines.english: “Stupid idea. What's so amusing about opening your guts? Even an apothecary wouldn't buy that booze-soaked liver of yours.”

lines.japanese: 意地悪くせせら笑う智里だったが、この男、本格的に自分の仕事を忘れているのではないかと疑わしい。が、すぐさますとんと落ち着いて智里は、懐手に頷[うなず]いた。
lines.english: Tomosato sneered maliciously. Had this man truly forgotten his own profession? Then he settled at once, tucked his hands inside his clothing, and nodded.

lines.japanese:
「───ま、それでもいいんだ多分。
　腹ン中にあろうが身に着けていようがどっちでも。おらいっちょ試してみ？」
lines.english: “Well, probably fine either way. In your belly, or worn on you. Come on, try it.”

lines.japanese: と無造作に、抜く手もみせずに舷側に一閃、その剣閃の速さもさりながら、朔屋にはそれまで智里が一体どこに刀を提げていたのかも見えず。無手だったのだ確かにそれまでは。分厚い舷側がたやすく断ち割られ、海へと開かれた時に朔屋が抱いた悪い予感は直後に証明された。
lines.english: Casually, without a visible draw, he sent a flash across the ship's side. Remarkable as the sword stroke's speed was, Sakuya had not even seen where he had been carrying the blade. His hands had certainly been empty until then. The thick side split easily, opening onto the sea. Sakuya's bad feeling was proven right an instant later.

lines.japanese: 智里が朔屋の腰を蹴ったぐり、叩き落としたのだ容赦なく。
lines.english: Tomosato kicked him in the hips and knocked him overboard without mercy.

lines.japanese: 「待っ、莫っ」
lines.english: “Wait, you id—”

lines.japanese: 待ても莫迦も言いきれず、落ちていくが酒の赤い水面へ、真っ逆様に悲鳴の緒も長く曳いて。
lines.english: Unable to finish either wait or idiot, he fell headfirst toward the red surface, trailing the long thread of a scream.

lines.japanese:
（ごばっ！　ばばばば莫迦あの人殺し、
　斬る代わりに溺れ死なすつもり───
　ごぼごばごぼごぼぼ───っ）
lines.english: (Gub! Y-y-y-you idiot, you killer! Drowning me instead of cutting me down—Glub-glub-glub—!)

lines.japanese:
（死んだ、今度こそ死んだ、
　苦しい、息が、
　ボコボコボコボコボコボコ───）
lines.english: (Dead. I'm dead this time. It hurts. I can't breathe—Blub-blub-blub-blub-blub-blub—)

lines.japanese: （ああ、なんだってこんな事に───）
lines.english: (Ah… Why did it come to this—?)

lines.japanese:
（苦しい苦しい、がば、がぼぼぼっ、
　溺れ死ぬのなんて厭だ、ひどすぎる───）
lines.japaneseRuby:
（苦しい苦しい、がば、がぼぼぼっ、
　溺れ死ぬのなんて[R厭^いや]だ、ひどすぎる───）
lines.english: (It hurts, it hurts… Gah, glub… I don't want to drown. Too horrible—)

lines.japanese:
真に溺死の危機に直面した者には、そこまで悠長に恐怖していられる暇などあるまい。
　実際───
lines.english: Someone truly about to drown would scarcely have the leisure to indulge in so much terror. In fact—

lines.japanese: 温く体にまとわりつく葡萄酒の海の中、朔屋、必死に四肢振り回してもがきにもがく。もがけどしかし息は続かず水面は見えず、ついに堪[た]えかねて口を開けたところで流れ込む赤い液体、瞬く間に肺の中まで浸されて、遂に朔屋、呼吸もできずに、海の藻屑───
lines.japaneseRuby: 温く体にまとわりつく葡萄酒の海の中、朔屋、必死に四肢振り回してもがきにもがく。もがけどしかし息は続かず水面は見えず、ついに堪[た]えかねて口を開けたところで流れ込む赤い液体、瞬く間に肺の中まで浸されて、遂に朔屋、呼吸もできずに、海の[R藻屑^もくず]───
lines.english: In the wine sea, warm liquid clung to his body. Sakuya flailed his limbs, struggling desperately. Still he could not hold his breath, could not see the surface. At last, unable to endure it, he opened his mouth. Red liquid poured in, instantly filling even his lungs. Unable to breathe, he was lost to the sea—

lines.japanese:
とはいかなかった。
　いかに人の肺は液体からでも酸素を得られるとはいっても、魚の鰓[えら]の様にはいかず、息続くわけないはずなのに、
　どういう奇跡なのか、朔屋は水中で呼吸が可能となっていたのだ。そればかりでなく、動くのも自在で、水の中の抵抗も上下感覚の混乱もなく、いともあっさりと水面に浮上する。
lines.english: Except he wasn't. Though human lungs could obtain oxygen even from liquid, they were not fish gills. His breath should never have lasted. Yet by some miracle, Sakuya could breathe underwater. More than that, he moved freely, without the water's resistance or confusion over which way was up. He surfaced with extraordinary ease.
“Huh—?”

lines.japanese:
赤い水面に上がってみれば、肺より葡萄酒吐き出される感触はやや気分に障[さわ]るものの、もちろん、息も普通に続く。
　不思議に頭を捻りつつ周囲見渡せば、間近に信天翁号の船体があり、海面まで垂らされたのは縄梯子。手に取り上らんと見上げてみれば、こちらは見下ろしている殺し屋の顔。朔屋、全身酒に夥[おびただ]しく濡れて上甲板に戻るのだった。
lines.english: Once above the red surface, the sensation of wine leaving his lungs was a little unpleasant. Naturally, however, he could breathe normally too. Puzzled, he looked about. The Albatross's hull was close by; a rope ladder hung down to the sea. Taking hold and looking up to climb, he found the killer's face gazing down. Drenched from head to foot in liquor, Sakuya returned to the upper deck.

lines.japanese: 「で、どうだったい、海水浴は」
lines.english: “Well? How was your swim?”

lines.japanese: 「どうもなにも、いったいどうなっちまったんだ、僕の体は。海の中だというのに、息は続くし苦しくもならない。ああ、そうか、僕はいよいよ魚になっちまったんだなぁ」
lines.english: “Never mind how it was. What on earth has happened to my body? Under the sea, I could breathe. No pain. Ah, I see. I've finally become a fish…”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そういうのは他にまかせておけよ」
lines.english: “No, leave that sort of thing to others.”

lines.japanese: しかし、朔屋は己の変化に頭が回る。この際、このふざけた殺し屋でもかまわない、誰か僕にまっとうな説明をしてくれと縋[すが]らん気持ちで智里を見れば、平素のにやけた顔もどこへやら、顎に手当てて思案顔。
lines.english: But Sakuya's thoughts turned to the change in his own body. Even this ridiculous killer would do: someone, give me a proper explanation. Almost ready to cling to him, he looked at Tomosato. The usual smirk had vanished. A hand at his chin, the man looked thoughtful.

lines.japanese: 「……水の中を酸素を取り出すだけでなく、人体を水中に適応させるような構造変換も行っているのか、あるいは単に体表面に力場を発生させて水の侵入を防いでいるのか」
lines.english: “…Not merely extracting oxygen from the water, but restructuring the human body to adapt it to immersion? Or simply generating a force field at its surface to keep the water out?”

lines.japanese: 朔屋には意味も通らぬことをぶつぶつと。さてはこの男、何か知ってると朔屋がその呟きに耳傾けようとしたところで、
lines.english: He muttered things Sakuya could not understand. So this man knew something! Just as Sakuya tried to listen more closely—

lines.japanese: 「ま、細かい仕組みなんぞ、俺だって知るかい」
lines.english: “Well, hell if I know the details.”

lines.japanese: と、あっさり己の思索、ぶん投げる。
lines.english: And with that, he blithely tossed his own theories aside.

lines.japanese: 「とにもかくにも、これでてめえがこの酒の海の中まで入っていけるってこった」
lines.english: “Anyway, you can go down into this sea of liquor now.”

lines.japanese:
「でもだって、息ができるのはいいとしても、
　僕は一体何処にどこに行って何をすればいいんだぁ……」
lines.english: “But… Fine, I can breathe. Where—where on earth am I supposed to go, and what am I supposed to do…?”

lines.japanese:
「そこまで俺が知るかいよ。
　まあ行き先は、
　てめえの腹ン中の真珠に訊けや」
lines.english: “How would I know that much? Ask the pearl in your belly where to go.”

lines.japanese: 「後はまあ、なるようになんだろうぜ」
lines.english: “After that, it'll work out however it works out.”
